Join the QC Fulfillment Technology team and be part of developing large-scale, composable, work-cell-based systems that power our micro-stores - from inbound receiving and guided stowing to picking, staging, and last-mile handoff. jobs.description:
**Company Description**
At Simple Energy, we are dedicated to accelerating the world’s transition to sustainable mobility by creating high-performance, design-forward electric scooters. Our flagship products, Simple One and Simple Dot One, offer industry-leading range, advanced acceleration, generous storage, and futuristic aesthetics that prioritize both practicality and purpose. With features such as up to 248 km range, top speeds of 105 kmph, and zero-rejection manufacturing standards, we set high benchmarks for quality and innovation in the EV space. Our values center on going beyond expectations, pushing technological and design boundaries, and maintaining excellence through long-term reliability, including an 8-year motor warranty. Simple Energy is more than a scooter manufacturer—it is a movement reshaping how people experience and envision electric mobility.

**Role Description**
The SDE I – Android HMI App role is a full-time, on-site position based in Bengaluru. This role focuses on designing, developing, and maintaining Android-based Human Machine Interface (HMI) applications that power the user experience on Simple Energy’s electric scooters. Day-to-day responsibilities include implementing new features, optimizing performance, fixing bugs, and ensuring seamless integration between the Android app, vehicle systems, and backend services. The team member will collaborate closely with product managers, UI/UX designers, and hardware and firmware engineers to translate requirements into robust, user-friendly interfaces. The role also involves writing clean, maintainable code, participating in code reviews, and contributing to testing and documentation to ensure reliability and safety in real-world environments.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and maintain HMI applications using Kotlin and modern Android development practices.
* Build reusable Jetpack Compose screens for dashboards, charging, vehicle controls, settings and notifications.
* Implement features within the existing architecture, following coding standards and production quality requirements.
* Integrate REST APIs, local settings and vehicle signals through established platform interfaces.
* Handle asynchronous updates using Coroutines and Flow, keeping UI state consistent with incoming data.
* Implement loading, error, offline and reconnection states, with appropriate guidance on vehicle-specific behavior.
* Support touch and joystick interactions, themes and feature availability across vehicle variants.
* Debug defects on HMI devices using ADB, Logcat and Android Studio; investigate logs and crash reports.
* Write unit and UI tests for assigned features and support QA during integration and release validation.
* Participate in code reviews and collaborate with design, platform, firmware, mobile, backend and QA teams.

**Required Skills**

* 1–3 years of professional Android application development experience.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics or a related engineering discipline.
* Good proficiency in Kotlin, object-oriented programming and Jetpack Compose.
* Hands-on experience with Android SDK, Android Studio, application lifecycle, navigation and permissions.
* Understanding of MVVM or MVI, ViewModels, state management and separation of UI and business logic.
* Working knowledge of Kotlin Coroutines, Flow, StateFlow and asynchronous programming.
* Experience integrating REST APIs, parsing JSON and handling network errors.
* Understanding of local persistence and dependency injection; familiarity with DataStore and Koin or equivalent tools.
* Basic familiarity with CAN communication, vehicle signals or automotive system integration concepts.
* Experience with Git, branches, pull requests and collaborative development workflows.
* Strong debugging, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work in an existing codebase.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to Bluetooth/BLE, GATT or connected-device communication.
* Experience with GPS, maps or navigation SDKs such as Mappls.
* Familiarity with JUnit, Compose UI testing, Firebase Crashlytics or Android profiling tools.
* Exposure to Media3/ExoPlayer, Lottie, Java interoperability or custom Android system services.
* Basic knowledge of Gradle, build variants, application signing and secure data handling.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical ability.
* Good understanding of Android fundamentals beyond UI development.
* Ability to take ownership of assigned features and deliver them with appropriate engineering guidance.
* Ability to understand requirements and translate them into maintainable technical solutions.
* Willingness to participate actively in design discussions and code reviews.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product, design, backend, QA, and other engineering teams.
* Curiosity to learn new technologies, platforms, and domain concepts.
* Focus on writing clean, maintainable, testable, and scalable code.

**Tech Stack**

**Core:**

Core: Kotlin • Jetpack Compose • Android SDK • MVVM • Coroutines • Flow • REST APIs • Git

**Supporting:**

Koin • Ktor • DataStore • CAN APIs • BLE • Mappls • Media3 • Firebase • JUnit • Gradle

**Role:**
Junior Firmware Engineer

**Function:**
Firmware / Embedded Systems Engineering

**Location:**
Bengaluru, India

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
Aviation & Aerospace

**About Company**

A venture-backed, seed-stage startup founded in 2023. The company is modernizing the spacecraft component supply chain for low-earth-orbit (LEO) satellite applications.

It specializes in Attitude Determination and Control System (ADCS) components — reaction wheels, star trackers, and torque rods. Headquartered in the US with operations in Bengaluru, India, the company serves satellite manufacturers and LEO constellation developers worldwide.

The team brings deep experience from high-volume space missions and is driven by a commitment to quality, affordability, and speed. The company has raised $2.2M in funding and is building critical infrastructure for the commercial space ecosystem.

**Position Overview**

This role is built for a hands-on firmware engineer who has explored embedded systems through academic projects or space club work and is ready to apply that curiosity in a real-world spacecraft hardware environment. The engineer will work on firmware for ADCS components — reaction wheels, star trackers, and torque rods — contributing to the full development cycle from bring-up to validation. This is a ground-floor opportunity to grow with a fast-moving deep-tech startup building critical infrastructure for the commercial space industry.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain firmware for ADCS hardware components including reaction wheels, star trackers, and torque rods
* Assist in bring-up, integration, and testing of embedded firmware on spacecraft subsystems
* Write and debug low-level embedded code for microcontrollers used in space-grade hardware
* Support hardware-software integration testing and document firmware behavior against hardware specifications
* Collaborate with hardware engineers to validate sensor interfaces and communication protocols
* Contribute to firmware version control, code reviews, and documentation practices
* Participate in troubleshooting and root cause analysis during component testing and qualification

**Must Have Criteria**

* 0–1 year of experience in firmware or embedded systems development (academic projects count)
* Hands-on project experience with microcontrollers — demonstrated through coursework, personal, or club projects
* Working knowledge of C for embedded/firmware development
* Exposure to communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, or CAN
* Active participation in a college space club, satellite team, or aerospace project (e.g., CanSat, CubeSat, rocketry, or ADCS subsystem work)

**Nice to Have**

* Project experience specifically on ADCS subsystems — attitude sensing, reaction wheels, or control algorithms
* Familiarity with RTOS concepts (FreeRTOS or similar) in an embedded context
* Exposure to hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing or spacecraft simulation environments
* Experience with version control tools such as Git in a team project setting
* Prior internship or project collaboration with a space startup, ISRO student program, or aerospace research lab

**What We Offer**

* Direct ownership of firmware modules on real spacecraft hardware from day one
* Mentorship from engineers with experience across multiple space missions
* Onsite role in Bengaluru embedded within a globally connected US-India team
* Ground-floor opportunity at a seed-stage startup shaping the commercial space supply chain

jobs.description:
**About Teleradiology Solutions / Daignostix**
Teleradiology Solutions (TRS), founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, provides 24x7 diagnostic radiology reporting to over 150 hospitals across 21 countries, through a network of radiologists (US, Indian certified) and technology-driven workflows.
  
  
Daignostix, the AI arm of TRS based in Whitefield, Bengaluru, builds clinical AI for medical imaging and healthcare workflows. TRS also maintains an active academic and research focus, including AI in radiology (www.radguru.net).
  
  
**Role Summary**
Daignostix builds the AI behind TRS's 24x7 teleradiology operations and the products used by radiologists, hospital partners and internal teams. Beyond clinical imaging models, this includes algorithms that route and prioritise cases, predict TAT and forecast volumes and radiologist coverage, along with mobile applications that put these capabilities in users' hands.
  
  
As a Junior AI Engineer – Applied AI (Non-Clinical), you will build and ship operational ML algorithms and AI-enabled mobile features end to end under the guidance of senior engineers, using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code to move quickly without compromising quality. This role does not work on clinical diagnostic models.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Operational algorithms. Build, train and evaluate models for case routing and worklist prioritisation, TAT prediction, radiologist scheduling and RVU/volume forecasting, and anomaly detection on operational data.
* Mobile AI features. Build AI-enabled features in mobile apps (React Native, Flutter or native iOS/Android) and integrate them with backend model services.
* On-device inference. Convert, optimize, and deploy machine learning models such as LightGBM, XGBoost, and scikit-learn models for production use, balancing accuracy, inference latency, memory usage, and model size.
* Data and evaluation. Build data pipelines from operational systems, define success metrics with operations stakeholders, and measure model impact against baselines in production.
* AI-assisted development. Use Claude Code and similar agentic coding tools in day-to-day development, while owning the review, testing and correctness of everything you ship.
* Production engineering. Package models as tested services (Python, Docker, FastAPI) with unit and regression tests, logging and monitoring. Senior engineers lead architecture and deployment.
* Stakeholder collaboration. Work with operations, product and engineering teams to turn workflow problems into measurable AI solutions.

**Requirements**
**Must-have:**

* Education. B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MS/M.Sc. from an IIT, IISc, IIIT, BITS Pilani or a comparably selective institution, in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic record.
* Experience. 2-4 years of hands-on software and ML engineering, including mobile applications and ML models that reached real users.
* Proof of building. At least one mobile app or ML system that you personally built and shipped to real users, and can defend in technical depth.
* Programming. Strong Python skills with hands-on experience in machine learning frameworks and libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, and LightGBM, along with proficiency in building and deploying production-grade ML solutions.
* AI-assisted development. Regular use of Claude Code or similar agentic coding tools on real projects, with sound judgement in reviewing and testing AI-generated code.
* ML fundamentals. Tabular, time-series and optimisation problems: feature engineering, gradient-boosted models, forecasting, classification metrics and experimental design.
* Engineering basics. Linux, Git, Docker, REST APIs, pytest and basic CI/CD.

**Good-to-have:**

* On-device ML. Experience deploying and optimizing machine learning models such as LightGBM, XGBoost, and scikit-learn models, including model compression, inference optimization, and efficient production deployment.
* Operations research. Scheduling, queueing or routing optimisation (e.g., OR-Tools).
* LLMs and cloud. LLM APIs, RAG or agent workflows, and one of AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Shipping experience. App store releases, mobile analytics and exposure to healthcare workflows.

**Key Skills**
Python | scikit-learn | XGBoost / LightGBM | Time-Series Forecasting | Optimisation / OR-Tools | React Native / Flutter | Swift / Kotlin | PyTorch | Core ML / TensorFlow Lite / ExecuTorch | Claude Code / AI-Assisted Development | FastAPI / REST APIs | Docker | Git | pytest | CI/CD | MLflow / Weights & Biases
  
  
**Why Join Daignostix**

* AI that runs the operation. Your algorithms directly shape how cases flow across a 24x7 global teleradiology service.
* Ship to real users. Build mobile and backend features used by radiologists, hospital partners and internal teams.
* Modern tooling with mentorship. Work with Claude Code and current AI tooling, with senior technical review and visibility from build to production.

Content Solutions Engineering, part of Apple’s IS&T organization, builds and maintains the Content Management systems — including Digital Asset Management (DAM) — that empower Apple’s business teams to author, manage, and publish content across a wide range of channels. We build the systems that sit behind every piece of content Apple’s customers and employees interact with, at scale and with high reliability. **Job Title**
Engineer - Java, AWS
  
  
**Job Description**
**So, who are we?**
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn’t pivot to innovation; it’s how we’ve always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that’s rare in established businesses.
  
  
The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we’ll give you the platform to define what comes next.
  
  
Join us at IG – the future gets built here.
  
  
**Your Team**
Join IG’s Prime Core team, which is responsible for building the open-spec trading APIs and solutions that support institutional and retail clients, delivering secure, high-performance, low-latency solutions.
  
  
**Your Role In The Team’s Success**
Our team sits within the IG Prime division, serving institutional and retail businesses. The Prime Core team owns the APIs that connect IG to institutional clients, brokers and partners across global markets — onboarding client accounts, funding, and the trading and market-data platform that our largest clients depend on every trading day.
  
  
That means real-time price distribution, order and execution flow, and reference data, running continuously through the trading day. When these systems degrade, clients notice immediately — so resilience, correctness and latency aren’t aspirations here; they’re the job. You’ll join at a genuinely interesting point: we’re building a new suite of cloud-native trading APIs.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Write production Java that other people have to maintain: tested, readable, and honest about its edge cases.
* Work in a spec-driven, AI-assisted development workflow — specifying intent clearly, using AI tooling to move fast, and reviewing what comes back with a critical eye.
* Contribute to design discussions and technical decisions. You won’t be handed a spec and left alone; you’ll be in the room while we work out what to build.
* Deploy and run what you build in AWS, and learn how the cloud behaves when things go wrong.
* Investigate production issues alongside more experienced engineers — working from logs, metrics, traces and JVM diagnostics to get from symptom to root cause under time pressure.
* Grow into deeper ownership of services as you build confidence in the systems.

**What You’ll Need**

* Experience: 3–5 years of professional Java development experience, including hands-on AWS.
* Java: solid commercial experience writing Java in a production environment — this is the core of the role, and the thing we’ll dig into most.
* JVM: a real understanding of how the JVM behaves at runtime — memory management and garbage collection, the Java memory model, and how threads actually interact rather than how we hope they do.

### MTS Silicon Design Engineer

### Job Summary

The focus of this role is to plan, build, and execute the verification of new and existing features for AMD's graphics processor IP, resulting in no bugs in the final design.

You have a passion for modern, complex processor architecture, digital design, and verification in general. ### Responsibilities

* Design and optimize onboard processing pipelines for SAR and MSI payloads.
* Convert raw payload data into Level-1 and Level-2 products directly on-orbit.
* Optimize compute, memory, power, and storage usage on satellite hardware.
* Develop high-performance software using C++, Rust, and Python.
* Develop high-performance software using frameworks like CUDA/OpenCL, ONNX Runtime etc.
* Accelerate algorithms on FPGA, ARM, GPU, and AI accelerator architectures.
* Implement data compression, transmission optimization, and edge AI inference.
* Build simulation and validation frameworks for pre-flight testing.
* Collaborate with payload, avionics, mission operations, and AI teams.

### Requirements

* Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science, Electronics, Aerospace, Robotics, or related field.
* 1+ years experience in relevant fields.
* Strong proficiency in C++ and Python.
* Experience with embedded systems, Linux, performance optimization, and parallel computing.
* Basic understanding of image processing, signal processing, or computer vision fundamentals.

### Benefits

* Experience in SAR processing, remote sensing, geospatial analytics, FPGA development, CUDA/OpenCL, ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, or edge AI deployment.
* Familiarity with satellite systems, space-grade hardware, CubeSats, or avionics software.
